title: Brewster's Tab
statusNote: Timestamps and amounts are rough estimates reconstructed from the film's story beats and have not yet been synced against a subtitle file.

events.label: Hackensack Bulls
events.detail: Monty Brewster, minor-league pitcher, is broke and happy enough.

events.label: Bailed out
events.detail: A stranger posts bail and whisks Monty off to Manhattan.

events.label: The will
events.detail: Great-uncle Rupert's terms: spend $30 million in 30 days and inherit $300 million. No assets left at the end.

events.label: Skips the wimp clause
events.detail: Monty passes on the guaranteed $1 million and takes the challenge.

events.label: Day one walking money
events.detail: First withdrawals and new wardrobes for Monty and Spike.

events.label: Luxury hotel suite
events.detail: A top-floor suite for the month, room service included.

events.label: Office lease
events.detail: Prime Manhattan office space, leased and furnished.

events.label: Hiring spree
events.detail: A full staff on very generous salaries. Wages are allowed; keeping things is not.

events.label: Limos and security
events.detail: Drivers, cars and a security detail on call around the clock.

events.label: The rare stamp
events.detail: Buys a priceless stamp, then uses it to mail a postcard. Gone.

events.label: Redecorating
events.detail: The office gets redone, top to bottom.

events.label: Investments built to fail
events.detail: Long-shot ventures picked specifically because they should lose money.

events.label: Bulls vs. Yankees
events.detail: Pays for an exhibition game: his minor-league Bulls against the New York Yankees.

events.label: A sure loser wins
events.detail: One of the doomed investments pays off. Terrible news.

events.label: Runs for mayor
events.detail: Launches a campaign urging New Yorkers to vote None of the Above.

events.label: Fender-bender payoff
events.detail: A minor car accident ends with Monty doing the paying.

events.label: Ad blitz
events.detail: TV spots, billboards, buttons. The message: don't vote for anybody.

events.label: Another accidental profit
events.detail: More money comes back in. The tab goes the wrong way.

events.label: Rallies and polling
events.detail: The campaign keeps spending as None of the Above gains ground.

events.label: Drops out
events.detail: Winning would be a disaster, so Monty quits the race.

events.label: The big party
events.detail: One enormous blowout for everyone he knows.

events.label: Settling every bill
events.detail: The last salaries and invoices go out as the deadline nears.

events.label: The final few dollars
events.detail: With seconds to spare, the last of the money goes to a lawyer's fee. Zero left.
Thirty million spent in thirty days. The inheritance is his.
